info.title: Table API
info.description: Allows you to perform create, read, update and delete (CRUD) operations on existing tables

get.description:
Retrieve records from a specified ServiceNow table such as `incident`, `change_request`, etc.

👉 LLM Instruction:
Before calling this endpoint, construct a valid `sysparm_query` string using the user's natural language request and ServiceNow GlideQuery syntax.

Use `^` for AND conditions and appropriate operators such as:
  - =, !=, IN, ISEMPTY, ISNOTEMPTY
  - Relative time: RELATIVEGT@dayofweek@ago@7
  - Date logic: javascript:gs.dateGenerate(...)

 Example:
- Prompt: "Show all open high-priority incidents that are unassigned"
- sysparm_query: active=true^priority=1^assigned_toISEMPTY

Only tables in the enum list are supported.

schema.description: Name of the table to query. Must be one of the supported tables.

parameters.description: Encoded query string used to filter the results. LLM should dynamically generate this string based on natural language using GlideQuery syntax.

parameters.description: Return field display values (`true`), actual values (`false`), or both (`all`) (default: `false`)

parameters.description: True to exclude Table API links for reference fields (default: false)

parameters.name: sysparm_suppress_pagination_header
parameters.description: True to suppress pagination header (default: false)

parameters.name: sysparm_fields
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of fields to return in the response

parameters.name: sysparm_limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results returned per page (default: 10,000)

parameters.name: sysparm_view
parameters.description: Render the response according to the specified UI view (overridden by sysparm_fields)

parameters.name: sysparm_query_category
